# TUNING — Assignment 6

Every revision records Claude's prediction, the strips before and after, Claude's comparison and my verdict in the running game (CHANGE-BRIEF.md; assignment Step 4). Strips are **fixture captures** of the preview scenes in `godot/previews/`, rendered by Movie Maker at 30 fps (`--fixed-fps 30`) with fixed seeds on the preview instances only. Files are numbered from 0, so strip frame N is `frameNNNNNNNN.png`.

## Effect A — Landing crumb puff

### 2026-11-07 — Effect A, r0: my first verdict, before Claude read anything
Strip: `captures/land_puff/r0/` (fixture capture; `land_puff_preview.tscn` with `retrigger` off; seeds 1001 and 1002; frames 10, 12, 15, 20, 30, 50). Effect settings: CHANGE-BRIEF.md Version 1, as built in commit `2bb6ebc`.
Where I looked: the running preview at the project's window size (1280 × 720), several runs, and the six strip frames.

What I saw (my words): In the live preview, I saw a quick puff that looked like white smoke under both jellies. At frame 12, it was easy to see on both the pale plate and the dark table. At frame 15, most of the crumbs were still under the jellies, so I didn't see the wide sideways fan I expected. The crumbs were gone by frame 20 and stayed gone in frames 30 and 50.

Claude's reading of r0: not yet requested.

### 2026-11-07 — Effect A, revision r1
What I saw (preview fixture and running game, 1280 × 720): my r0 verdict above. At frame 15 most crumbs were still under the jellies, with no wide sideways fan. In the running game a puff appeared at the jelly's feet on every landing, and the puffs all looked the same to me. On my r0 plate-edge attempt in the running game, I didn't see the two puffs overlap. That helped motivate trying a more visible sideways spread. I haven't verified overlap in r1.

Claude's reading of r0 (`sessions/a6/session-4a-reading.md`): frames 10, 30 and 50 match the intent; frame 12 does not have crumbs "out from behind both sides"; frame 15 fails, with a few crumbs just outside one edge and nothing near a jelly width out; frame 20 is empty. Its explanation: the LAND sprite is about 78 px wide, wider than the 52 px collision box the brief was sized to, and the push is too weak to carry crumbs past the visible edge. It read the frames unzoomed, because its three image-crop commands were denied.

Change: `radial_accel_curve` (`CurveTexture`) `(0, 1), (0.2, 0)` → `(0, 1), (0.18, 1), (0.2, 0)`, linear, approved by me. `radial_accel_min` / `radial_accel_max` unchanged at 4000 / 6500. Claude first proposed doubling the radial range to 8000 / 13000; I chose its curve-only alternative instead (`sessions/a6/prompt-4b.txt`). The agent made the edit and updated the configuration test's expected curve points (`sessions/a6/session-4c-reply.md`). My config run: 51 checks / 0 failures, exit 0.

Claude's prediction for r1 (`sessions/a6/session-4b-prediction.md`): frame 10 unchanged; frame 12 crumbs still mostly behind the jelly, no crumb centre clearing the visible edge, so still short of the brief; frame 15 about 60–75 % of crumbs clear the edge, mostly by 5–35 px, at most about 40 px, low, short of one jelly width; frame 20 empty or a few faint specks; frames 30 and 50 empty. Risk named: about one stray crumb per puff kicked upward. A cross-check simulation by Claude in chat (not Claude Code) used the same timing assumption and also predicted almost nothing past the edge at frame 12.

Claude's comparison of r1 with its prediction (`sessions/a6/session-4d-comparison.md`): frames 10, 20, 30 and 50 match. Frame 12 does **not** match: crumbs show about 5–15 px past both edges of both jellies, about 10 px further than predicted. Frame 15 partly matches: low fans on both sides of both jellies, near crumbs and height as predicted, but the farthest reach about 36–49 px beyond the visible edges, about 10 px beyond its predicted maximum; no stray high crumb seen. Its explanation: its model was one frame off, because the preview starts emission in `_process()` on frame 10 and frame 10 already shows crumbs, so frame 10 + n shows crumbs (n + 1)/30 s old. Inferred from the frames, not checked in Godot's source. Against the brief: frame 12 roughly meets "out from behind both sides"; frame 15 reaches about 0.7–0.95 of a jelly width beyond the edge, a little short of "about one jelly width".

My verdict (running game, 1280 × 720): **kept**, because the puff was easy to see when the jelly landed in the running game. In the frame comparison, r1 was already wider at frame 12 and spread farther past both sides by frame 15.

Strips: `captures/land_puff/r0/`, `captures/land_puff/r1/` (fixture captures, seeds 1001 and 1002, same preview).
Commits: the curve change (agent, approved by me), then strip r1, then this verdict with the brief revision, in that order.

## Effect B — Dome sugar glints

### 2026-11-07 — Effect B, r0: my first verdict, before Claude read anything
Strip: `captures/dome_glints/r0/` (fixture capture; `dome_glints_preview.tscn`; seed 2001 on the preview instance only; `restart()` at frame 10, `emitting = false` at frame 70; Movie Maker at 30 fps, 150 frames; strip frames 10, 12, 40, 70, 85, 145). Effect settings: CHANGE-BRIEF.md Version 1, as built in commit `f2e5b26`.
Where I looked: the running preview at the project's window size (1280 × 720) and the r0 capture.

What I saw (my words): I ran the live preview and checked the Effect B r0 capture myself. The glints were already visible around the dome at frame 10, and I saw more of them there than at frame 40. I didn't notice them thinning out by frame 85. By frame 145, no glints were visible.

Claude's reading of r0: not yet requested.

### 2026-11-07 — Effect B, revision r1
What I saw (preview fixture and running game, 1280 × 720): my r0 verdict above. The glints were already visible at frame 10, with more there than at frame 40, and no thinning by frame 85. In the running game they were visible when the dome first appeared in the intro, faded gradually after I won, and were easy to see against both the dark wall and the glass.

Claude's reading of r0 (`sessions/a6/session-7a-reading.md`): frames 10, 12, 70 and 145 match the intent; 40 and 85 miss it. It counted about 14 visible dots at frame 10 and about 9 at 40, mostly over the glass, and no thinning from 70 to 85. Its explanation: alpha and size both climb over the first 0.2 of life (about 0.48 s), so the glints missing after the stop are the ones still fading in, and the brief's "fades in over about 0.5 s" contradicts its frame-85 "fewer near the glass". It also inferred, untested, that `lifetime_randomness = 0.3` only shortens lives (1.68–2.4 s), so fewer than 24 are alive on average. It read the frames unzoomed, because its two image-crop commands were denied.

Change: `color_ramp` (`Gradient_life`) offsets `(0, 0.2, 0.75, 1)` → `(0, 0.08, 0.75, 1)`, colours unchanged, approved by me. `scale_curve` unchanged. The agent made the edit and updated the configuration test's `RAMP_OFFSETS` (`sessions/a6/session-7b-reply.md`). My config run: 45 checks / 0 failures, exit 0.

Claude's prediction for r1 (`sessions/a6/session-7a-reading.md`): same positions as r0; frame 10 a few more small bright dots low in the glass, about 16 to 18 visible; frame 40 about 12 to 14, still well under 24 and mostly over the glass; frame 70 full; frame 85 the lower glass visibly emptier than at 70, 3 to 5 fewer dots; frame 145 empty.

My byte comparison (Terminal, `cmp` on each r0/r1 strip-frame pair): frames 10, 12, 40, 70 and 85 differ between r0 and r1, and frame 145 is identical, so the change took effect in the render.

Claude's comparison of r1 with its prediction (`sessions/a6/session-7c-comparison.md`): its `shasum` command was denied, so it compared file sizes instead. Its visual review found the same positions and motion as r0, but no extra visible dots at 10 or 40 (about 9 at 40), and no clearer thinning from 70 to 85 than in r0 (the file shrinks by 543 bytes in r1 and 539 in r0). Its explanation: young glints are still tiny while `scale_curve` grows them, so size, not alpha, limits how visible they are; it called its count prediction its own mistake.

My own look at the strips: the two frame-40 images looked nearly identical. A pair of screenshots looked slightly less crowded inside the glass at frame 85 than at frame 70, but Preview didn't show which capture folder that pair came from, so I don't count it as a confirmed r1 result.

Where Claude and I disagree: at full frame size Claude saw no visible difference between r0 and r1, while in the running game I found the glints noticeably easier to see in the intro. My verdict in the running game decides.

My verdict (running game, 1280 × 720): **kept**. I watched the intro in the running game, and the glints were noticeably easier to see. I couldn't tell whether they were brighter or whether more were visible. The frame comparison didn't show clearer thinning from frame 70 to 85, so I'm keeping r1 for how it looks in the intro.

Strips: `captures/dome_glints/r0/`, `captures/dome_glints/r1/` (fixture captures, seed 2001, same preview).
Commits: the ramp change (agent, approved by me), then strip r1 with Claude's comparison, then this verdict with the brief revision, in that order.

## A7 — landing, r0 (first verdict, mine, written before any Claude reading)

Capture: `captures/land/r0/clean/` and `captures/land/r0/overlay/` (fixture frames from `res://previews/land_preview.tscn`, Movie Maker at 30 fps, run by me with `sessions/a7/capture_strips.sh`; full sequences outside the repo). I also played the preview windowed at normal speed and at `--time-scale 0.25`.

- **Impact, hold, and rise:** Yes. The landing looked smooth at normal speed. In the clean frames, Jelly compresses on contact in 105, reaches its deepest squash in 106, holds it in 107, then rises in 108. The hold was easier to see frame by frame.
- **Seam:** I didn't see an obvious gap, overlap, or line where the two pieces meet during the squash or rise.
- **Feet:** Yes. At quarter speed, Jelly's bottom edge stayed planted on the plate as it squashed and rose.
- **Return to IDLE:** I didn't notice a pop. Between frames 108 and 109, Jelly gets a little taller while its bottom edge stays in the same spot relative to the plate.

Every revision records Claude's prediction, the strips before and after, Claude's comparison and my verdict in the running game (CHANGE-BRIEF.md; assignment Step 4). Strips are **fixture captures** of the preview scenes in `godot/previews/`, rendered by Movie Maker at 30 fps (`--fixed-fps 30`) with fixed seeds on the preview instances only. Files are numbered from 0, so strip frame N is `frameNNNNNNNN.png`.

## Effect A — Landing crumb puff

### 2026-11-07 — Effect A, r0: my first verdict, before Claude read anything
Strip: `captures/land_puff/r0/` (fixture capture; `land_puff_preview.tscn` with `retrigger` off; seeds 1001 and 1002; frames 10, 12, 15, 20, 30, 50). Effect settings: CHANGE-BRIEF.md Version 1, as built in commit `2bb6ebc`.
Where I looked: the running preview at the project's window size (1280 × 720), several runs, and the six strip frames.

What I saw (my words): In the live preview, I saw a quick puff that looked like white smoke under both jellies. At frame 12, it was easy to see on both the pale plate and the dark table. At frame 15, most of the crumbs were still under the jellies, so I didn't see the wide sideways fan I expected. The crumbs were gone by frame 20 and stayed gone in frames 30 and 50.

Claude's reading of r0: not yet requested.

### 2026-11-07 — Effect A, revision r1
What I saw (preview fixture and running game, 1280 × 720): my r0 verdict above. At frame 15 most crumbs were still under the jellies, with no wide sideways fan. In the running game a puff appeared at the jelly's feet on every landing, and the puffs all looked the same to me. On my r0 plate-edge attempt in the running game, I didn't see the two puffs overlap. That helped motivate trying a more visible sideways spread. I haven't verified overlap in r1.

Claude's reading of r0 (`sessions/a6/session-4a-reading.md`): frames 10, 30 and 50 match the intent; frame 12 does not have crumbs "out from behind both sides"; frame 15 fails, with a few crumbs just outside one edge and nothing near a jelly width out; frame 20 is empty. Its explanation: the LAND sprite is about 78 px wide, wider than the 52 px collision box the brief was sized to, and the push is too weak to carry crumbs past the visible edge. It read the frames unzoomed, because its three image-crop commands were denied.

Change: `radial_accel_curve` (`CurveTexture`) `(0, 1), (0.2, 0)` → `(0, 1), (0.18, 1), (0.2, 0)`, linear, approved by me. `radial_accel_min` / `radial_accel_max` unchanged at 4000 / 6500. Claude first proposed doubling the radial range to 8000 / 13000; I chose its curve-only alternative instead (`sessions/a6/prompt-4b.txt`). The agent made the edit and updated the configuration test's expected curve points (`sessions/a6/session-4c-reply.md`). My config run: 51 checks / 0 failures, exit 0.

Claude's prediction for r1 (`sessions/a6/session-4b-prediction.md`): frame 10 unchanged; frame 12 crumbs still mostly behind the jelly, no crumb centre clearing the visible edge, so still short of the brief; frame 15 about 60–75 % of crumbs clear the edge, mostly by 5–35 px, at most about 40 px, low, short of one jelly width; frame 20 empty or a few faint specks; frames 30 and 50 empty. Risk named: about one stray crumb per puff kicked upward. A cross-check simulation by Claude in chat (not Claude Code) used the same timing assumption and also predicted almost nothing past the edge at frame 12.

Claude's comparison of r1 with its prediction (`sessions/a6/session-4d-comparison.md`): frames 10, 20, 30 and 50 match. Frame 12 does **not** match: crumbs show about 5–15 px past both edges of both jellies, about 10 px further than predicted. Frame 15 partly matches: low fans on both sides of both jellies, near crumbs and height as predicted, but the farthest reach about 36–49 px beyond the visible edges, about 10 px beyond its predicted maximum; no stray high crumb seen. Its explanation: its model was one frame off, because the preview starts emission in `_process()` on frame 10 and frame 10 already shows crumbs, so frame 10 + n shows crumbs (n + 1)/30 s old. Inferred from the frames, not checked in Godot's source. Against the brief: frame 12 roughly meets "out from behind both sides"; frame 15 reaches about 0.7–0.95 of a jelly width beyond the edge, a little short of "about one jelly width".

My verdict (running game, 1280 × 720): **kept**, because the puff was easy to see when the jelly landed in the running game. In the frame comparison, r1 was already wider at frame 12 and spread farther past both sides by frame 15.

Strips: `captures/land_puff/r0/`, `captures/land_puff/r1/` (fixture captures, seeds 1001 and 1002, same preview).
Commits: the curve change (agent, approved by me), then strip r1, then this verdict with the brief revision, in that order.

## Effect B — Dome sugar glints

### 2026-11-07 — Effect B, r0: my first verdict, before Claude read anything
Strip: `captures/dome_glints/r0/` (fixture capture; `dome_glints_preview.tscn`; seed 2001 on the preview instance only; `restart()` at frame 10, `emitting = false` at frame 70; Movie Maker at 30 fps, 150 frames; strip frames 10, 12, 40, 70, 85, 145). Effect settings: CHANGE-BRIEF.md Version 1, as built in commit `f2e5b26`.
Where I looked: the running preview at the project's window size (1280 × 720) and the r0 capture.

What I saw (my words): I ran the live preview and checked the Effect B r0 capture myself. The glints were already visible around the dome at frame 10, and I saw more of them there than at frame 40. I didn't notice them thinning out by frame 85. By frame 145, no glints were visible.

Claude's reading of r0: not yet requested.

### 2026-11-07 — Effect B, revision r1
What I saw (preview fixture and running game, 1280 × 720): my r0 verdict above. The glints were already visible at frame 10, with more there than at frame 40, and no thinning by frame 85. In the running game they were visible when the dome first appeared in the intro, faded gradually after I won, and were easy to see against both the dark wall and the glass.

Claude's reading of r0 (`sessions/a6/session-7a-reading.md`): frames 10, 12, 70 and 145 match the intent; 40 and 85 miss it. It counted about 14 visible dots at frame 10 and about 9 at 40, mostly over the glass, and no thinning from 70 to 85. Its explanation: alpha and size both climb over the first 0.2 of life (about 0.48 s), so the glints missing after the stop are the ones still fading in, and the brief's "fades in over about 0.5 s" contradicts its frame-85 "fewer near the glass". It also inferred, untested, that `lifetime_randomness = 0.3` only shortens lives (1.68–2.4 s), so fewer than 24 are alive on average. It read the frames unzoomed, because its two image-crop commands were denied.

Change: `color_ramp` (`Gradient_life`) offsets `(0, 0.2, 0.75, 1)` → `(0, 0.08, 0.75, 1)`, colours unchanged, approved by me. `scale_curve` unchanged. The agent made the edit and updated the configuration test's `RAMP_OFFSETS` (`sessions/a6/session-7b-reply.md`). My config run: 45 checks / 0 failures, exit 0.

Claude's prediction for r1 (`sessions/a6/session-7a-reading.md`): same positions as r0; frame 10 a few more small bright dots low in the glass, about 16 to 18 visible; frame 40 about 12 to 14, still well under 24 and mostly over the glass; frame 70 full; frame 85 the lower glass visibly emptier than at 70, 3 to 5 fewer dots; frame 145 empty.

My byte comparison (Terminal, `cmp` on each r0/r1 strip-frame pair): frames 10, 12, 40, 70 and 85 differ between r0 and r1, and frame 145 is identical, so the change took effect in the render.

Claude's comparison of r1 with its prediction (`sessions/a6/session-7c-comparison.md`): its `shasum` command was denied, so it compared file sizes instead. Its visual review found the same positions and motion as r0, but no extra visible dots at 10 or 40 (about 9 at 40), and no clearer thinning from 70 to 85 than in r0 (the file shrinks by 543 bytes in r1 and 539 in r0). Its explanation: young glints are still tiny while `scale_curve` grows them, so size, not alpha, limits how visible they are; it called its count prediction its own mistake.

My own look at the strips: the two frame-40 images looked nearly identical. A pair of screenshots looked slightly less crowded inside the glass at frame 85 than at frame 70, but Preview didn't show which capture folder that pair came from, so I don't count it as a confirmed r1 result.

Where Claude and I disagree: at full frame size Claude saw no visible difference between r0 and r1, while in the running game I found the glints noticeably easier to see in the intro. My verdict in the running game decides.

My verdict (running game, 1280 × 720): **kept**. I watched the intro in the running game, and the glints were noticeably easier to see. I couldn't tell whether they were brighter or whether more were visible. The frame comparison didn't show clearer thinning from frame 70 to 85, so I'm keeping r1 for how it looks in the intro.

## A7 — landing, r0 (first verdict, mine, written before any Claude reading)

Capture: `captures/land/r0/clean/` and `captures/land/r0/overlay/` (fixture frames from `res://previews/land_preview.tscn`, Movie Maker at 30 fps, run by me with `sessions/a7/capture_strips.sh`; full sequences outside the repo). - **Return to IDLE:** I didn't notice a pop. Between frames 108 and 109, Jelly gets a little taller while its bottom edge stays in the same spot relative to the plate.

1	extends SceneTree
2	## A7 Step 4: read-back of the saved land clip and the landing rig in player_visuals.tscn
3	## (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, "Rig design", "Scene, authority and states", "Clocks and boundaries").
4	## Loads the scene from its file, instantiates it under root, inspects it and quits.
5	## Read-only: builds, keys, plays and seeks nothing. Headless structure checks; not a render
6	## check and not human playtesting.
7	
8	const SCENE_PATH := "res://features/player/player_visuals.tscn"
9	const LAND_PATH := "res://animations/land.tres"
10	const IDLE_PATH := "res://assets/art/CHAR-IDLE.png"
11	const P_LOWER_SCALE := "FacingPivot/LandRig/LowerPivot:scale"
12	const P_UPPER_POS := "FacingPivot/LandRig/UpperPivot:position"
13	const P_UPPER_SCALE := "FacingPivot/LandRig/UpperPivot:scale"
14	const P_FORBIDDEN := "FacingPivot/LandRig/LowerPivot:position"
15	const TIME_TOL := 0.5 / 60.0
16	const VAL_TOL := 1e-4
17	const SEAM_TOL := 1e-3
18	const REST_Y := -20.14
19	
20	const KEY_TIMES := [0.0, 2.0 / 60.0, 4.0 / 60.0, 8.0 / 60.0]
21	const KEY_TRANSITIONS := [2.0, 1.0, 0.5, 1.0]
22	const KEY_VALUES := {
23		P_LOWER_SCALE: [Vector2(1.05, 0.85), Vector2(1.15, 0.60), Vector2(1.15, 0.60), Vector2(1.0, 1.0)],
24		P_UPPER_POS: [Vector2(0, -17.119), Vector2(0, -12.084), Vector2(0, -12.084), Vector2(0, -20.14)],
25		P_UPPER_SCALE: [Vector2(1.05, 0.90), Vector2(1.15, 0.73), Vector2(1.15, 0.73), Vector2(1.0, 1.0)],
26	}
27	
28	var checks := 0
29	var failures := 0
30	
31	func check(id: String, passed: bool, observed: String) -> void:
32		checks += 1
33		if not passed:
34			failures += 1
35		print("%s %s: %s" % ["PASS" if passed else "FAIL", id, observed])
36	
37	func near(a: float, b: float, tol: float) -> bool:
38		return absf(a - b) <= tol
39	
40	func near2(a: Vector2, b: Vector2, tol: float) -> bool:
41		return absf(a.x - b.x) <= tol and absf(a.y - b.y) <= tol
42	
43	func v2s(v: Vector2) -> String:
44		return "(%.6f, %.6f)" % [v.x, v.y]
45	
46	## From the A7 assignment handout, unchanged (copied from test_a7_scoot_readback.gd).
47	static func track_problems(player: AnimationPlayer) -> Array[String]:
48		var problems: Array[String] = []
49		var root := player.get_node_or_null(player.root_node)
50		if root == null:
51			problems.append("root_node %s resolves to nothing" % player.root_node)
52			return problems
53		for clip_name in player.get_animation_list():
54			var clip := player.get_animation(clip_name)
55			for t in clip.get_track_count():
56				var path := clip.track_get_path(t)
57				var node := root.get_node_or_null(NodePath(path.get_concatenated_names()))
58				if node == null:
59					problems.append("%s track %d: no node at %s" % [clip_name, t, path])
60					continue
61				if path.get_subname_count() == 0:
62					continue
63				var sub := path.get_subname(0)
64				match clip.track_get_type(t):
65					Animation.TYPE_POSITION_3D, Animation.TYPE_ROTATION_3D, Animation.TYPE_SCALE_3D:
66						var skeleton := node as Skeleton3D
67						if skeleton == null or skeleton.find_bone(sub) == -1:
68							problems.append("%s track %d: no bone %s on %s" % [clip_name, t, sub, node.name])
69					Animation.TYPE_BLEND_SHAPE:
70						var mesh := node as MeshInstance3D
71						if mesh == null or mesh.find_blend_shape_by_name(sub) == -1:
72							problems.append("%s track %d: no blend shape %s on %s" % [clip_name, t, sub, node.name])
73					_:
74						if not (sub in node):
75							problems.append("%s track %d: %s has no property %s" % [clip_name, t, node.name, sub])
76		return problems
77	
78	func _initialize() -> void:
79		call_deferred("run")
80	
81	func has_prop(cls: String, prop: String) -> bool:
82		for p in ClassDB.class_get_property_list(cls, true):
83			if p["name"] == prop:
84				return true
85		return false
86	
87	var has_interpolate := false
88	
89	func check_classdb() -> void:
90		print("ENGINE %s" % Engine.get_version_info().string)
91		for pair in [["Animation", "loop_mode"], ["Animation", "step"], ["Animation", "length"],
92				["Sprite2D", "region_enabled"], ["Sprite2D", "region_rect"], ["Sprite2D", "offset"],
93				["Sprite2D", "centered"], ["CanvasItem", "texture_filter"]]:
94			check("classdb-property %s.%s" % pair, has_prop(pair[0], pair[1]), "declared on %s (no_inheritance)" % pair[0])
95		for pair in [["Animation", "LOOP_NONE"], ["Animation", "UPDATE_CONTINUOUS"], ["Animation", "INTERPOLATION_LINEAR"],
96				["Animation", "TYPE_VALUE"], ["CanvasItem", "TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS"]]:
97			var ok := ClassDB.class_has_integer_constant(pair[0], pair[1])
98			check("classdb-constant %s.%s" % pair, ok, "value %d" % ClassDB.class_get_integer_constant(pair[0], pair[1]) if ok else "missing")
99		for pair in [["Animation", "value_track_get_update_mode"], ["Animation", "track_get_interpolation_type"],
100				["Animation", "track_get_key_transition"], ["Animation", "track_get_key_time"]]:
101			check("classdb-method %s.%s" % pair, ClassDB.class_has_method(pair[0], pair[1]), "")
102		has_interpolate = ClassDB.class_has_method("Animation", "value_track_interpolate")
103		check("classdb-method Animation.value_track_interpolate", has_interpolate, "present" if has_interpolate else "MISSING on this build; between-key samples not taken")
104	
105	func run() -> void:
106		check_classdb()
107	
108		var packed := load(SCENE_PATH) as PackedScene
109		check("scene-loads", packed != null, SCENE_PATH)
110		if packed == null:
111			finish()
112			return
113		var visuals := packed.instantiate()
114		root.add_child(visuals)
115	
116		# --- Rig nodes
117		var land_rig := visuals.get_node_or_null("FacingPivot/LandRig")
118		var lower_pivot := visuals.get_node_or_null("FacingPivot/LandRig/LowerPivot") as Node2D
119		var upper_pivot := visuals.get_node_or_null("FacingPivot/LandRig/UpperPivot") as Node2D
120		var lower_sprite := visuals.get_node_or_null("FacingPivot/LandRig/LowerPivot/LowerSprite") as Sprite2D
121		var upper_sprite := visuals.get_node_or_null("FacingPivot/LandRig/UpperPivot/UpperSprite") as Sprite2D
122		check("LandRig Node2D under FacingPivot", land_rig != null and land_rig.get_class() == "Node2D" and str(land_rig.get_parent().name) == "FacingPivot", str(land_rig))
123		check("LowerPivot Node2D under LandRig", lower_pivot != null and lower_pivot.get_class() == "Node2D", str(lower_pivot))
124		check("UpperPivot Node2D under LandRig", upper_pivot != null and upper_pivot.get_class() == "Node2D", str(upper_pivot))
125		check("LowerSprite Sprite2D under LowerPivot", lower_sprite != null and lower_sprite.get_class() == "Sprite2D", str(lower_sprite))
126		check("UpperSprite Sprite2D under UpperPivot", upper_sprite != null and upper_sprite.get_class() == "Sprite2D", str(upper_sprite))
127		var scripted: Array[String] = []
128		var stack: Array[Node] = [visuals]
129		while not stack.is_empty():
130			var n: Node = stack.pop_back()
131			if n.get_script() != null:
132				scripted.append(str(visuals.get_path_to(n)))
133			stack.append_array(n.get_children())
134		check("no scripts on any node", scripted.is_empty(), str(scripted))
135		if lower_pivot == null or upper_pivot == null or lower_sprite == null or upper_sprite == null:
136			finish()
137			return
138	
139		check("LowerPivot rest position (0, 0)", lower_pivot.position == Vector2.ZERO, v2s(lower_pivot.position))
140		check("LowerPivot rest scale (1, 1)", lower_pivot.scale == Vector2.ONE, v2s(lower_pivot.scale))
141		check("UpperPivot rest position (0, -20.14)", near2(upper_pivot.position, Vector2(0, REST_Y), VAL_TOL), v2s(upper_pivot.position))
142		check("UpperPivot rest scale (1, 1)", upper_pivot.scale == Vector2.ONE, v2s(upper_pivot.scale))
143	
144		for entry in [["LowerSprite", lower_sprite, Rect2(0, 622, 1024, 402), Vector2(-512, -190)],
145				["UpperSprite", upper_sprite, Rect2(0, 0, 1024, 622), Vector2(-512, -622)]]:
146			var nm: String = entry[0]
147			var s: Sprite2D = entry[1]
148			var tex_path := s.texture.resource_path if s.texture != null else "<null>"
149			check("%s texture path" % nm, tex_path == IDLE_PATH, tex_path)
150			check("%s region_enabled true" % nm, s.region_enabled == true, str(s.region_enabled))
151			check("%s region_rect %s" % [nm, entry[2]], s.region_rect == entry[2], str(s.region_rect))
152			check("%s offset %s" % [nm, entry[3]], s.offset == entry[3], str(s.offset))
153			check("%s centered false" % nm, s.centered == false, str(s.centered))
154			check("%s position (0, 0)" % nm, s.position == Vector2.ZERO, v2s(s.position))
155			check("%s scale (0.106, 0.106)" % nm, s.scale.is_equal_approx(Vector2(0.106, 0.106)), v2s(s.scale))
156			check("%s texture_filter LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS" % nm, s.texture_filter == CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS, "%d (constant %d)" % [s.texture_filter, CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS])
157	
158		# --- AnimationPlayer and library
159		var player := visuals.get_node_or_null("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
160		check("AnimationPlayer present", player != null, str(player))
161		if player == null:
162			finish()
163			return
164		var libs := player.get_animation_library_list()
165		check("exactly one library, the default \"\"", libs.size() == 1 and libs[0] == &"", str(libs))
166		check("no RESET animation", not player.has_animation(&"RESET"), str(player.get_animation_list()))
167		check("clip scoot exists", player.has_animation(&"scoot"), str(player.get_animation_list()))
168		check("clip land exists", player.has_animation(&"land"), str(player.get_animation_list()))
169		var problems := track_problems(player)
170		for p in problems:
171			print("  track problem: " + p)
172		check("every track of every clip resolves (track_problems)", problems.is_empty(), "%d problems over clips %s" % [problems.size(), player.get_animation_list()])
173		if not player.has_animation(&"land"):
174			finish()
175			return
176		var clip := player.get_animation(&"land")
177		check("land resource path", clip.resource_path == LAND_PATH, clip.resource_path)
178	
179		# --- Clip settings
180		check("length 8/60", near(clip.length, 8.0 / 60.0, TIME_TOL), "%.10f vs %.10f" % [clip.length, 8.0 / 60.0])
181		check("step 1/60", is_equal_approx(clip.step, 1.0 / 60.0), "%.10f vs %.10f" % [clip.step, 1.0 / 60.0])
182		check("loop_mode LOOP_NONE", clip.loop_mode == Animation.LOOP_NONE, "%d (constant %d)" % [clip.loop_mode, Animation.LOOP_NONE])
183	
184		# --- Tracks
185		var n_tracks := clip.get_track_count()
186		check("land has exactly three tracks", n_tracks == 3, str(n_tracks))
187		var paths: Array[String] = []
188		for t in n_tracks:
189			paths.append(str(clip.track_get_path(t)))
190		var expected_paths: Array[String] = [P_LOWER_SCALE, P_UPPER_POS, P_UPPER_SCALE]
191		var sorted_paths := paths.duplicate()
192		sorted_paths.sort()
193		var sorted_expected := expected_paths.duplicate()
194		sorted_expected.sort()
195		check("track paths are exactly the three rig paths", sorted_paths == sorted_expected, str(paths))
196		check("no track on %s" % P_FORBIDDEN, not (P_FORBIDDEN in paths), str(paths))
197	
198		var idx := {}
199		for t in n_tracks:
200			var path: String = paths[t]
201			idx[path] = t
202			var is_value := clip.track_get_type(t) == Animation.TYPE_VALUE
203			check("track %d (%s) type TYPE_VALUE" % [t, path], is_value, "%d (constant %d)" % [clip.track_get_type(t), Animation.TYPE_VALUE])
204			if is_value:
205				var mode := clip.value_track_get_update_mode(t)
206				check("track %d (%s) update mode CONTINUOUS" % [t, path], mode == Animation.UPDATE_CONTINUOUS, "%d (constant %d)" % [mode, Animation.UPDATE_CONTINUOUS])
207			else:
208				check("track %d (%s) update mode CONTINUOUS" % [t, path], false, "not a value track; update mode not read")
209			var interp := clip.track_get_interpolation_type(t)
210			check("track %d (%s) interpolation LINEAR" % [t, path], interp == Animation.INTERPOLATION_LINEAR, "%d (constant %d)" % [interp, Animation.INTERPOLATION_LINEAR])
211	
212		# --- Keys
213		var keys_ok := true
214		for path in expected_paths:
215			if not idx.has(path):
216				check("%s present for key checks" % path, false, "missing")
217				keys_ok = false
218				continue
219			var t: int = idx[path]
220			var n_keys := clip.track_get_key_count(t)
221			check("%s has four keys" % path, n_keys == 4, str(n_keys))
222			if n_keys != 4:
223				keys_ok = false
224				continue
225			for k in 4:
226				var kt := clip.track_get_key_time(t, k)
227				check("%s key %d time %.6f" % [path, k, KEY_TIMES[k]], near(kt, KEY_TIMES[k], TIME_TOL), "%.10f (diff %.10f)" % [kt, kt - KEY_TIMES[k]])
228				var kv = clip.track_get_key_value(t, k)
229				var vok: bool = typeof(kv) == TYPE_VECTOR2 and near2(kv, KEY_VALUES[path][k], VAL_TOL)
230				check("%s key %d value %s" % [path, k, KEY_VALUES[path][k]], vok, "%s (type %s)" % [v2s(kv) if typeof(kv) == TYPE_VECTOR2 else str(kv), type_string(typeof(kv))])
231				if typeof(kv) != TYPE_VECTOR2:
232					keys_ok = false
233				var tr := clip.track_get_key_transition(t, k)
234				check("%s key %d transition %.1f" % [path, k, KEY_TRANSITIONS[k]], near(tr, KEY_TRANSITIONS[k], VAL_TOL), "%.6f" % tr)
235	
236		if keys_ok:
237			var tl: int = idx[P_LOWER_SCALE]
238			var tp: int = idx[P_UPPER_POS]
239			var tu: int = idx[P_UPPER_SCALE]
240			for k in 4:
241				var ls: Vector2 = clip.track_get_key_value(tl, k)
242				var up: Vector2 = clip.track_get_key_value(tp, k)
243				var us: Vector2 = clip.track_get_key_value(tu, k)
244				check("key %d equal widths (LowerPivot.scale.x == UpperPivot.scale.x)" % k, near(ls.x, us.x, VAL_TOL), "%.6f vs %.6f" % [ls.x, us.x])
245				check("key %d UpperPivot.position.x == 0" % k, near(up.x, 0.0, VAL_TOL), "%.6f" % up.x)
246				var seam := REST_Y * ls.y
247				check("key %d seam UpperPivot.position.y == -20.14 * LowerPivot.scale.y" % k, near(up.y, seam, SEAM_TOL), "%.6f vs %.6f (diff %.8f)" % [up.y, seam, up.y - seam])
248			# Frame-8 key equals the scene's rest values.
249			var ls8: Vector2 = clip.track_get_key_value(tl, 3)
250			var up8: Vector2 = clip.track_get_key_value(tp, 3)
251			var us8: Vector2 = clip.track_get_key_value(tu, 3)
252			check("frame-8 LowerPivot:scale equals scene rest", near2(ls8, lower_pivot.scale, VAL_TOL), "%s vs %s" % [v2s(ls8), v2s(lower_pivot.scale)])
253			check("frame-8 UpperPivot:position equals scene rest", near2(up8, upper_pivot.position, VAL_TOL), "%s vs %s" % [v2s(up8), v2s(upper_pivot.position)])
254			check("frame-8 UpperPivot:scale equals scene rest", near2(us8, upper_pivot.scale, VAL_TOL), "%s vs %s" % [v2s(us8), v2s(upper_pivot.scale)])
255	
256			# --- Between keys (Animation.value_track_interpolate)
257			if not has_interpolate:
258				check("between-key samples via value_track_interpolate", false, "method missing on this build; not worked around")
259			else:
260				for frame: int in [1, 3, 5, 6, 7]:
261					var time: float = frame / 60.0
262					var s_ls: Vector2 = clip.call("value_track_interpolate", tl, time)
263					var s_up: Vector2 = clip.call("value_track_interpolate", tp, time)
264					var s_us: Vector2 = clip.call("value_track_interpolate", tu, time)
265					print("SAMPLE frame %d t=%.6f LowerPivot:scale %s UpperPivot:position %s UpperPivot:scale %s" % [frame, time, v2s(s_ls), v2s(s_up), v2s(s_us)])
266					var seam := REST_Y * s_ls.y
267					check("frame %d seam UpperPivot.position.y == -20.14 * LowerPivot.scale.y" % frame, near(s_up.y, seam, SEAM_TOL), "%.6f vs %.6f (diff %.8f)" % [s_up.y, seam, s_up.y - seam])
268					check("frame %d equal widths" % frame, near(s_ls.x, s_us.x, SEAM_TOL), "%.6f vs %.6f" % [s_ls.x, s_us.x])
269					if frame == 6:
270						check("frame 6 width 1.0375", near(s_ls.x, 1.0375, SEAM_TOL), "%.6f" % s_ls.x)
271						check("frame 6 LowerPivot scale.y 0.90", near(s_ls.y, 0.90, SEAM_TOL), "%.6f" % s_ls.y)
272						check("frame 6 UpperPivot scale.y 0.9325", near(s_us.y, 0.9325, SEAM_TOL), "%.6f" % s_us.y)
273						check("frame 6 UpperPivot position.y -18.126", near(s_up.y, -18.126, SEAM_TOL), "%.6f (display %.2f)" % [s_up.y, s_up.y])
274	
275		finish()

278		print("A7 LAND READBACK: %d checks / %d failures" % [checks, failures])

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# sessions/a7/capture_strips.sh — A7 Step 7: the LAND and SCOOT fixture strips (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, "Evidence and frame
3	# strips"). Written by the agent (Step 7a session); Kiran reviews and runs it. Every frame it keeps is a FIXTURE
4	# frame from res://previews/*_preview.tscn, not gameplay evidence; landing-r0 stays the separate gameplay reference.
5	#
6	# Usage, from the repository root (needs a window; do not press keys in the Godot window while it records):
7	#   bash sessions/a7/capture_strips.sh
8	#
9	# 1. Refuses to start if captures/land/r0, captures/scoot/r0 or any ~/Documents/a7-reference/captures-full/<run>
10	#    directory already exists.
11	# 2. Runs windowed Movie Maker three times, each run's output teed to a log:
12	#      land  --fixed-fps 30                     -> captures/land/r0/clean/    log captures/land/r0/land_clean.log
13	#      land  --fixed-fps 30 --debug-collisions  -> captures/land/r0/overlay/  log captures/land/r0/land_overlay.log
14	#      scoot --fixed-fps 60                     -> captures/scoot/r0/         log captures/scoot/r0/scoot.log
15	#    Movie Maker writes frame<NNNNNNNN>.png, one per rendered frame counted from 0 (and frame.wav).
16	# 3. Checks every run before anything is moved: Godot exit 0, the preview's own result line with problems=0, no
17	#    SCRIPT ERROR / Failed loading resource, contiguous FRAME lines, contiguous PNG numbers from 0, and
18	#    PNG count == FRAME line count. PNG index = FRAME index - (index of the first FRAME line); the offset is printed.
19	#    Land: the TRIGGER frame's PNG exists, and frames trigger-1 .. trigger+4 show FALL, rig 0, 2, 4, 6 and IDLE at
20	#    tick 8 in the log. Scoot: one frame before, on and after every SWAP and WRAP line, with the expected cell and
21	#    clip frame. Every kept PNG must be 1280 x 720.
22	# 4. Only if every check passed: moves each run's full Movie Maker output (all frame* files) to
23	#    ~/Documents/a7-reference/captures-full/<run>/ (with a copy of its log), then copies the frames to read back into
24	#    the repository under names that carry the rig frame or clip frame, and prints a table of them.
25	# If anything fails it prints STOPPED and exits 1. A failure in step 3 moves nothing; the captures stay where
26	# Movie Maker wrote them.
27	
28	set -Eeuo pipefail
29	trap 'rc=$?; echo "STOPPED: command \"$BASH_COMMAND\" failed with exit $rc (line $LINENO)" >&2' ERR
30	
31	stop() {
32		echo "STOPPED: $*" >&2
33		exit 1
34	}
35	
36	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- preflight (nothing is created before these pass)
37	
38	REPO="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
39	if [ "$(pwd -P)" != "$(cd "$REPO" && pwd -P)" ]; then
40		stop "run this from the repository root: $REPO"
41	fi
42	LAND_DIR="captures/land/r0"
43	SCOOT_DIR="captures/scoot/r0"
44	CLEAN_DIR="$LAND_DIR/clean"
45	OVERLAY_DIR="$LAND_DIR/overlay"
46	CLEAN_LOG="$LAND_DIR/land_clean.log"
47	OVERLAY_LOG="$LAND_DIR/land_overlay.log"
48	SCOOT_LOG="$SCOOT_DIR/scoot.log"
49	EXT="$HOME/Documents/a7-reference/captures-full"
50	EXT_CLEAN="$EXT/land-r0-clean"
51	EXT_OVERLAY="$EXT/land-r0-overlay"
52	EXT_SCOOT="$EXT/scoot-r0"
53	WANT_SIZE="1280 x 720"
54	
55	for d in "$LAND_DIR" "$SCOOT_DIR"; do
56		if [ -e "$d" ]; then
57			stop "$d already exists. Check what it is and move it yourself; this script never overwrites a capture."
58		fi
59	done
60	for d in "$EXT_CLEAN" "$EXT_OVERLAY" "$EXT_SCOOT"; do
61		if [ -e "$d" ]; then
62			stop "$d already exists. Move it aside first; this script never overwrites a full sequence."
63		fi
64	done
65	for tool in git godot timeout tee awk sed grep sort wc tr file mkdir mv cp; do
66		if ! command -v "$tool" > /dev/null; then
67			stop "required command not found: $tool"
68		fi
69	done
70	for f in godot/previews/land_preview.tscn godot/previews/land_preview.gd godot/previews/scoot_preview.tscn godot/previews/scoot_preview.gd; do
71		if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then
72			stop "$f is missing"
73		fi
74	done
75	
76	echo "capture_strips.sh: HEAD $(git rev-parse HEAD), godot $(godot --version)"
77	echo "Do not press keys in the Godot window while it records: real key events reach the game."
78	
79	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
80	
81	strip_ansi() {   # file -> stdout without terminal colour codes
82		LC_ALL=C sed -e $'s/\033\\[[0-9;]*m//g' "$1"
83	}
84	
85	kv() {           # line key -> the value of key=value in the line, or nothing
86		awk -v k="$2" '{ for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if (index($i, k "=") == 1) { print substr($i, length(k) + 2); exit } }' <<< "$1"
87	}
88	
89	clip_frame() {   # clip time in seconds -> nearest 1/60 s timeline frame
90		awk -v t="$1" 'BEGIN { printf "%d", t * 60 + 0.5 }'
91	}
92	
93	near_frame() {   # clip time, frame: exit 0 if the time is that frame within 1e-3 frame
94		awk -v t="$1" -v n="$2" 'BEGIN { d = t * 60 - n; if (d < 0) d = -d; exit (d < 0.001 ? 0 : 1) }'
95	}
96	
97	run_capture() {  # label fps scene outdir log debug_collisions(0|1)
98		local label="$1" fps="$2" scene="$3" outdir="$4" log="$5" debug="$6" rc=0 bad flags
99		mkdir -p "$outdir"
100		flags="--fixed-fps $fps"
101		if [ "$debug" = "1" ]; then
102			flags="$flags --debug-collisions"
103		fi
104		echo
105		echo "=== $label: Movie Maker, $flags, $scene -> $outdir/"
106		if [ "$debug" = "1" ]; then
107			timeout 1800 godot --path godot --fixed-fps "$fps" --debug-collisions --write-movie "$REPO/$outdir/frame.png" "$scene" 2>&1 | tee "$log" || rc=$?
108		else
109			timeout 1800 godot --path godot --fixed-fps "$fps" --write-movie "$REPO/$outdir/frame.png" "$scene" 2>&1 | tee "$log" || rc=$?
110		fi
111		if [ "$rc" != "0" ]; then
112			stop "$label: godot (or tee) exited $rc; see $log. Nothing was moved."
113		fi
114		bad="$( { strip_ansi "$log" | grep -cE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Failed loading resource'; } || true)"
115		if [ "$bad" != "0" ]; then
116			stop "$label: $bad SCRIPT ERROR / Failed loading resource lines in $log. Nothing was moved."
117		fi
118		echo "$label: godot exit 0"
119	}
120	
121	FRAMES_TXT=""
122	F0=""
123	NFR=""
124	load_frames() {  # label log: FRAME lines into FRAMES_TXT; first index F0; count NFR; checks they are contiguous
125		FRAMES_TXT="$( { strip_ansi "$2" | grep -E '^FRAME [0-9]+ '; } || true)"
126		if [ -z "$FRAMES_TXT" ]; then
127			stop "$1: no FRAME lines in $2"
128		fi
129		NFR="$(wc -l <<< "$FRAMES_TXT" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
130		F0="$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' <<< "$FRAMES_TXT")"
131		if ! awk 'NR == 1 { f0 = $2 } $2 != f0 + NR - 1 { bad = 1 } END { exit bad ? 1 : 0 }' <<< "$FRAMES_TXT"; then
132			stop "$1: FRAME indices in $2 are not contiguous"
133		fi
134	}
135	
136	frame_line() {   # index -> the FRAME line with that process-frame index (from FRAMES_TXT)
137		awk -v f="$1" '$1 == "FRAME" && $2 == f { print; exit }' <<< "$FRAMES_TXT"
138	}
139	
140	NPNG=""
141	W=""
142	check_pngs() {   # label dir: counts frame<N>.png in NPNG, digit width in W; checks the numbers are 0..NPNG-1
143		local names nums
144		names="$( { ls "$2" | grep -E '^frame[0-9]+\.png$'; } || true)"
145		if [ -z "$names" ]; then
146			stop "$1: Movie Maker wrote no frame<N>.png in $2"
147		fi
148		NPNG="$(wc -l <<< "$names" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
149		W="$(awk 'NR == 1 { print length($0) - 9 }' <<< "$names")"
150		if ! awk -v w="$W" 'length($0) - 9 != w { bad = 1 } END { exit bad ? 1 : 0 }' <<< "$names"; then
151			stop "$1: PNG names in $2 do not all have $W digits"
152		fi
153		nums="$(sed -E 's/^frame0*([0-9]+)\.png$/\1/' <<< "$names" | sort -n)"
154		if ! awk '$1 != NR - 1 { bad = 1 } END { exit bad ? 1 : 0 }' <<< "$nums"; then
155			stop "$1: PNG numbers in $2 are not contiguous from 0"
156		fi
157	}
158	
159	png_name() {     # index -> frame<index, W digits>.png
160		printf "frame%0${W}d.png" "$1"
161	}
162	
163	check_size() {   # label png
164		local size
165		size="$( { file -b "$2" | grep -oE '[0-9]+ x [0-9]+' | head -n 1; } || true)"
166		if [ "$size" != "$WANT_SIZE" ]; then
167			stop "$1: $2 is '${size:-unknown}', expected $WANT_SIZE. Nothing was moved."
168		fi
169	}
170	
171	map_run() {      # label outdir log: loads FRAME lines and PNGs, checks the counts match, prints the offset
172		load_frames "$1" "$3"
173		check_pngs "$1" "$2"
174		if [ "$NPNG" != "$NFR" ]; then
175			stop "$1: Movie Maker wrote $NPNG PNGs but $3 has $NFR FRAME lines, so PNGs cannot be matched to log frames. Nothing was moved."
176		fi
177		echo "$1: $NPNG PNGs = $NFR FRAME lines; first FRAME line is process frame $F0, so PNG index = FRAME index - $F0 (offset $F0)"
178	}
179	
180	KEEP=""          # one line per kept frame: outdir \t ext \t source png \t new name \t frame \t png \t tick \t pose \t clip \t t \t cell \t expect
181	keep() {
182		KEEP="$KEEP$(printf '%s\t' "$@")"$'\n'
183	}
184	
185	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- land: trigger - 1 .. trigger + 4
186	
187	CLEAN_TRIGGER=""
188	OVERLAY_TRIGGER=""
189	select_land() {  # variant(clean|overlay) outdir log ext
190		local variant="$1" outdir="$2" log="$3" ext="$4" label="land $1"
191		local result trig n tf td aligned tp rel fr line pose clip t tick cell rel_tick rig tag expect png ok
192		map_run "$label" "$outdir" "$log"
193		result="$( { strip_ansi "$log" | grep -E '^LAND PREVIEW: .* problems=0$'; } || true)"
194		if [ -z "$result" ]; then
195			stop "$label: no 'LAND PREVIEW: ... problems=0' line in $log (see its PROBLEM lines)"
196		fi
197		trig="$( { strip_ansi "$log" | grep -E '^TRIGGER '; } || true)"
198		n=0
199		if [ -n "$trig" ]; then
200			n="$(wc -l <<< "$trig" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
201		fi
202		if [ "$n" != "1" ]; then
203			stop "$label: expected exactly one TRIGGER line in $log, found $n"
204		fi
205		tf="$(kv "$trig" frame)"
206		td="$(kv "$trig" touchdown_tick)"
207		aligned="$(kv "$trig" aligned)"
208		if [ "$aligned" != "true" ]; then
209			stop "$label: TRIGGER line says aligned=$aligned: $trig"
210		fi
211		tp=$((tf - F0))
212		if [ ! -f "$outdir/$(png_name "$tp")" ]; then
213			stop "$label: TRIGGER frame $tf -> PNG index $tp, but $outdir/$(png_name "$tp") does not exist"
214		fi
215		echo "$label: TRIGGER frame=$tf (touchdown tick $td) -> PNG index $tp = $(png_name "$tp")"
216		if [ "$variant" = "clean" ]; then
217			CLEAN_TRIGGER="$tf/$tp"
218		else
219			OVERLAY_TRIGGER="$tf/$tp"
220		fi
221		for rel in -1 0 1 2 3 4; do
222			fr=$((tf + rel))
223			png=$((fr - F0))
224			line="$(frame_line "$fr")"
225			if [ -z "$line" ]; then
226				stop "$label: no FRAME line for trigger $rel (frame $fr)"
227			fi
228			pose="$(kv "$line" pose)"
229			clip="$(kv "$line" clip)"
230			t="$(kv "$line" t)"
231			tick="$(kv "$line" tick)"
232			cell="$(kv "$line" cell)"
233			rel_tick=$((tick - td))
234			ok=1
235			case "$rel" in
236				-1)
237					[ "$pose" = "FALL" ] && [ "$clip" = "-" ] || ok=0
238					tag="trig-1_FALL"
239					expect="Airborne FALL before contact"
240					;;
241				4)
242					[ "$pose" = "IDLE" ] && [ "$clip" = "-" ] && [ "$rel_tick" = "8" ] || ok=0
243					tag="trig+4_tick8_IDLE-handoff"
244					expect="Tick 8: IDLE hand-off without a pop, seam or anchor shift"
245					;;
246				*)
247					rig=$((2 * rel))
248					if [ "$pose" != "LAND" ] || [ "$clip" != "land" ] || [ "$rel_tick" != "$rig" ] || ! near_frame "$t" "$rig"; then
249						ok=0
250					fi
251					case "$rel" in
252						0) tag="trig+0_rig0_impact"; expect="Frame 0: partial squash and planted feet" ;;
253						1) tag="trig+1_rig2_deepest-squash"; expect="Frame 2: deepest squash, about the height of the low box" ;;
254						2) tag="trig+2_rig4_same-squash"; expect="Frame 4: same squash, now beginning recovery" ;;
255						3) tag="trig+3_rig6_eased-rise"; expect="Frame 6: eased rise, joined cut and fixed feet" ;;
256					esac
257					;;
258			esac
259			if [ "$ok" != "1" ]; then
260				stop "$label: trigger $rel (frame $fr) does not show what the strip needs ($tag): $line"
261			fi
262			check_size "$label" "$outdir/$(png_name "$png")"
263			keep "$outdir" "$ext" "$(png_name "$png")" "land_${variant}_${tag}_png$(printf "%0${W}d" "$png").png" \
264				"$fr" "$png" "$tick" "$pose" "$clip" "$t" "$cell" "$expect"
265		done
266	}
267	
268	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scoot: one before, on and one after every swap and wrap
269	
270	select_scoot() { # outdir log ext
271		local outdir="$1" log="$2" ext="$3" label="scoot"
272		local result events n ev kind kind_lc f dir k pos off fr png line pose clip t tick cell cf want_cell want_cf expect
273		local right_swap=0 right_wrap=0 left_swap=0 left_wrap=0
274		map_run "$label" "$outdir" "$log"
275		result="$( { strip_ansi "$log" | grep -E '^SCOOT PREVIEW: .* problems=0$'; } || true)"
276		if [ -z "$result" ]; then
277			stop "$label: no 'SCOOT PREVIEW: ... problems=0' line in $log (see its PROBLEM lines)"
278		fi
279		events="$( { strip_ansi "$log" | grep -E '^(SWAP|WRAP) '; } || true)"
280		if [ -z "$events" ]; then
281			stop "$label: no SWAP or WRAP lines in $log"
282		fi
283		n="$(wc -l <<< "$events" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
284		echo "$label: $n SWAP/WRAP lines"
285		while IFS= read -r ev; do
286			kind="$(awk '{ print $1 }' <<< "$ev")"
287			kind_lc="$(tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' <<< "$kind")"
288			f="$(kv "$ev" frame)"
289			dir="$(kv "$ev" dir)"
290			case "$dir/$kind" in
291				right/SWAP) right_swap=$((right_swap + 1)); k=$right_swap ;;
292				right/WRAP) right_wrap=$((right_wrap + 1)); k=$right_wrap ;;
293				left/SWAP) left_swap=$((left_swap + 1)); k=$left_swap ;;
294				left/WRAP) left_wrap=$((left_wrap + 1)); k=$left_wrap ;;
295				*) stop "$label: unexpected event line: $ev" ;;
296			esac
297			for pos in before on after; do
298				case "$pos" in
299					before) off=-1 ;;
300					on) off=0 ;;
301					after) off=1 ;;
302				esac
303				fr=$((f + off))
304				png=$((fr - F0))
305				line="$(frame_line "$fr")"
306				if [ -z "$line" ]; then
307					stop "$label: no FRAME line $pos $kind at frame $f"
308				fi
309				pose="$(kv "$line" pose)"
310				clip="$(kv "$line" clip)"
311				t="$(kv "$line" t)"
312				tick="$(kv "$line" tick)"
313				cell="$(kv "$line" cell)"
314				if [ "$clip" != "scoot" ]; then
315					stop "$label: frame $fr ($pos $kind at $f) is not in the scoot clip: $line"
316				fi
317				cf="$(clip_frame "$t")"
318				case "$kind/$pos" in
319					SWAP/before) want_cell=0; want_cf=6; expect="Cell 0 (A), last tick of the A hold" ;;
320					SWAP/on) want_cell=1; want_cf=7; expect="Cell 1 (B) at the swap: feet registered, no jump" ;;
321					SWAP/after) want_cell=1; want_cf=8; expect="Cell 1 (B), second tick of the B hold" ;;
322					WRAP/before) want_cell=1; want_cf=13; expect="Cell 1 (B), last frame of the loop" ;;
323					WRAP/on) want_cell=0; want_cf=0; expect="Cell 0 (A) at the wrap: no hesitation, feet registered" ;;
324					WRAP/after) want_cell=0; want_cf=1; expect="Cell 0 (A), second tick of the A hold" ;;
325				esac
326				if [ "$cell" != "$want_cell" ] || [ "$cf" != "$want_cf" ] || ! near_frame "$t" "$want_cf"; then
327					stop "$label: frame $fr ($pos $kind at $f) shows cell $cell at clip frame $cf, expected cell $want_cell at $want_cf: $line"
328				fi
329				check_size "$label" "$outdir/$(png_name "$png")"
330				keep "$outdir" "$ext" "$(png_name "$png")" \
331					"scoot_${dir}_${kind_lc}${k}_${pos}_clip${cf}_cell${cell}_png$(printf "%0${W}d" "$png").png" \
332					"$fr" "$png" "$tick" "$pose" "$clip" "$t" "$cell" "$expect, facing $dir"
333			done
334		done <<< "$events"
335		echo "$label: right $right_swap swaps, $right_wrap wraps; left $left_swap swaps, $left_wrap wraps"
336		if [ "$right_swap" -lt 2 ] || [ "$right_wrap" -lt 2 ] || [ "$left_swap" -lt 2 ] || [ "$left_wrap" -lt 2 ]; then
337			stop "$label: expected at least two swaps and two wraps in each direction"
338		fi
339	}
340	
341	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- move the full sequences out, copy the kept frames back
342	
343	move_full() {    # outdir ext log
344		local outdir="$1" ext="$2" log="$3" f left
345		mkdir -p "$ext"
346		for f in "$outdir"/frame*; do
347			if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
348				stop "no Movie Maker files to move in $outdir"
349			fi
350			mv -n "$f" "$ext/"
351		done
352		left="$( { ls "$outdir" | grep -cE '^frame'; } || true)"
353		if [ "$left" != "0" ]; then
354			stop "$left Movie Maker files are still in $outdir after the move"
355		fi
356		cp "$log" "$ext/"
357		echo "moved the full sequence: $outdir/frame* -> $ext/ (with a copy of $(basename "$log"))"
358	}
359	
360	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- run
361	
362	run_capture "land clean" 30 res://previews/land_preview.tscn "$CLEAN_DIR" "$CLEAN_LOG" 0
363	run_capture "land overlay" 30 res://previews/land_preview.tscn "$OVERLAY_DIR" "$OVERLAY_LOG" 1
364	run_capture "scoot" 60 res://previews/scoot_preview.tscn "$SCOOT_DIR" "$SCOOT_LOG" 0
365	
366	echo
367	echo "=== checks (nothing is moved unless all pass)"
368	select_land clean "$CLEAN_DIR" "$CLEAN_LOG" "$EXT_CLEAN"
369	select_land overlay "$OVERLAY_DIR" "$OVERLAY_LOG" "$EXT_OVERLAY"
370	if [ "$CLEAN_TRIGGER" = "$OVERLAY_TRIGGER" ]; then
371		echo "land: clean and overlay TRIGGER frame/PNG are the same: $CLEAN_TRIGGER"
372	else
373		echo "land: NOTE clean TRIGGER frame/PNG $CLEAN_TRIGGER differs from overlay $OVERLAY_TRIGGER (each run checked on its own)"
374	fi
375	select_scoot "$SCOOT_DIR" "$SCOOT_LOG" "$EXT_SCOOT"
376	
377	echo
378	echo "=== moving"
379	move_full "$CLEAN_DIR" "$EXT_CLEAN" "$CLEAN_LOG"
380	move_full "$OVERLAY_DIR" "$EXT_OVERLAY" "$OVERLAY_LOG"
381	move_full "$SCOOT_DIR" "$EXT_SCOOT" "$SCOOT_LOG"
382	kept=0
383	while IFS=$'\t' read -r outdir ext src name _rest; do
384		if [ -z "$outdir" ]; then
385			continue
386		fi
387		if [ ! -f "$ext/$src" ]; then
388			stop "$ext/$src missing after the move"
389		fi
390		if [ -e "$outdir/$name" ]; then
391			stop "$outdir/$name already exists (a frame kept twice?)"
392		fi
393		cp "$ext/$src" "$outdir/$name"
394		kept=$((kept + 1))
395	done <<< "$KEEP"
396	
397	echo
398	echo "=== kept frames ($kept): FIXTURE frames from res://previews/, not gameplay evidence"
399	printf '%-58s %6s %6s %6s %-8s %-6s %-9s %4s  %s\n' "file" "frame" "png" "tick" "pose" "clip" "t" "cell" "should show"
400	while IFS=$'\t' read -r outdir ext src name fr png tick pose clip t cell expect; do
401		if [ -z "$outdir" ]; then
402			continue
403		fi
404		printf '%-58s %6s %6s %6s %-8s %-6s %-9s %4s  %s\n' "$name" "$fr" "$png" "$tick" "$pose" "$clip" "$t" "$cell" "$expect"
405	done <<< "$KEEP"
406	echo
407	echo "Kept frames: $CLEAN_DIR/, $OVERLAY_DIR/, $SCOOT_DIR/ (logs beside them). Full sequences: $EXT/."
408	echo "RESULT: all three captures checked; $kept frames kept."
409

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# sessions/a7/capture_strips.sh — A7 Step 7: the LAND and SCOOT fixture strips (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, "Evidence and frame
# strips"). Written by the agent (Step 7a session); Kiran reviews and runs it. Every frame it keeps is a FIXTURE
# frame from res://previews/*_preview.tscn, not gameplay evidence; landing-r0 stays the separate gameplay reference.
#
# Usage, from the repository root (needs a window; do not press keys in the Godot window while it records):
#   bash sessions/a7/capture_strips.sh
#
# 1. Refuses to start if captures/land/r0, captures/scoot/r0 or any ~/Documents/a7-reference/captures-full/<run>
#    directory already exists.
# 2. Runs windowed Movie Maker three times, each run's output teed to a log:
#      land  --fixed-fps 30                     -> captures/land/r0/clean/    log captures/land/r0/land_clean.log
#      land  --fixed-fps 30 --debug-collisions  -> captures/land/r0/overlay/  log captures/land/r0/land_overlay.log
#      scoot --fixed-fps 60                     -> captures/scoot/r0/         log captures/scoot/r0/scoot.log
#    Movie Maker writes frame<NNNNNNNN>.png, one per rendered frame counted from 0 (and frame.wav).
# 3. Checks every run before anything is moved: Godot exit 0, the preview's own result line with problems=0, no
#    SCRIPT ERROR / Failed loading resource, contiguous FRAME lines, contiguous PNG numbers from 0, and
#    PNG count == FRAME line count. PNG index = FRAME index - (index of the first FRAME line); the offset is printed.
#    Land: the TRIGGER frame's PNG exists, and frames trigger-1 .. trigger+4 show FALL, rig 0, 2, 4, 6 and IDLE at
#    tick 8 in the log. Scoot: one frame before, on and after every SWAP and WRAP line, with the expected cell and
#    clip frame. Every kept PNG must be 1280 x 720.
# 4. Only if every check passed: moves each run's full Movie Maker output (all frame* files) to
#    ~/Documents/a7-reference/captures-full/<run>/ (with a copy of its log), then copies the frames to read back into
#    the repository under names that carry the rig frame or clip frame, and prints a table of them.
# If anything fails it prints STOPPED and exits 1. A failure in step 3 moves nothing; the captures stay where
# Movie Maker wrote them.

set -Eeuo pipefail
trap 'rc=$?; echo "STOPPED: command \"$BASH_COMMAND\" failed with exit $rc (line $LINENO)" >&2' ERR

stop() {
	echo "STOPPED: $*" >&2
	exit 1
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- preflight (nothing is created before these pass)

REPO="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
if [ "$(pwd -P)" != "$(cd "$REPO" && pwd -P)" ]; then
	stop "run this from the repository root: $REPO"
fi
LAND_DIR="captures/land/r0"
SCOOT_DIR="captures/scoot/r0"
CLEAN_DIR="$LAND_DIR/clean"
OVERLAY_DIR="$LAND_DIR/overlay"
CLEAN_LOG="$LAND_DIR/land_clean.log"
OVERLAY_LOG="$LAND_DIR/land_overlay.log"
SCOOT_LOG="$SCOOT_DIR/scoot.log"
EXT="$HOME/Documents/a7-reference/captures-full"
EXT_CLEAN="$EXT/land-r0-clean"
EXT_OVERLAY="$EXT/land-r0-overlay"
EXT_SCOOT="$EXT/scoot-r0"
WANT_SIZE="1280 x 720"

for d in "$LAND_DIR" "$SCOOT_DIR"; do
	if [ -e "$d" ]; then
		stop "$d already exists. Check what it is and move it yourself; this script never overwrites a capture."
	fi
done
for d in "$EXT_CLEAN" "$EXT_OVERLAY" "$EXT_SCOOT"; do
	if [ -e "$d" ]; then
		stop "$d already exists. Move it aside first; this script never overwrites a full sequence."
	fi
done
for tool in git godot timeout tee awk sed grep sort wc tr file mkdir mv cp; do
	if ! command -v "$tool" > /dev/null; then
		stop "required command not found: $tool"
	fi
done
for f in godot/previews/land_preview.tscn godot/previews/land_preview.gd godot/previews/scoot_preview.tscn godot/previews/scoot_preview.gd; do
	if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then
		stop "$f is missing"
	fi
done

echo "capture_strips.sh: HEAD $(git rev-parse HEAD), godot $(godot --version)"
echo "Do not press keys in the Godot window while it records: real key events reach the game."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

strip_ansi() {   # file -> stdout without terminal colour codes
	LC_ALL=C sed -e $'s/\033\\[[0-9;]*m//g' "$1"
}

kv() {           # line key -> the value of key=value in the line, or nothing
	awk -v k="$2" '{ for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if (index($i, k "=") == 1) { print substr($i, length(k) + 2); exit } }' <<< "$1"
}

clip_frame() {   # clip time in seconds -> nearest 1/60 s timeline frame
	awk -v t="$1" 'BEGIN { printf "%d", t * 60 + 0.5 }'
}

near_frame() {   # clip time, frame: exit 0 if the time is that frame within 1e-3 frame
	awk -v t="$1" -v n="$2" 'BEGIN { d = t * 60 - n; if (d < 0) d = -d; exit (d < 0.001 ? 0 : 1) }'
}

run_capture() {  # label fps scene outdir log debug_collisions(0|1)
	local label="$1" fps="$2" scene="$3" outdir="$4" log="$5" debug="$6" rc=0 bad flags
	mkdir -p "$outdir"
	flags="--fixed-fps $fps"
	if [ "$debug" = "1" ]; then
		flags="$flags --debug-collisions"
	fi
	echo
	echo "=== $label: Movie Maker, $flags, $scene -> $outdir/"
	if [ "$debug" = "1" ]; then
		timeout 1800 godot --path godot --fixed-fps "$fps" --debug-collisions --write-movie "$REPO/$outdir/frame.png" "$scene" 2>&1 | tee "$log" || rc=$?
	else
		timeout 1800 godot --path godot --fixed-fps "$fps" --write-movie "$REPO/$outdir/frame.png" "$scene" 2>&1 | tee "$log" || rc=$?
	fi
	if [ "$rc" != "0" ]; then
		stop "$label: godot (or tee) exited $rc; see $log. Nothing was moved."
	fi
	bad="$( { strip_ansi "$log" | grep -cE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Failed loading resource'; } || true)"
	if [ "$bad" != "0" ]; then
		stop "$label: $bad SCRIPT ERROR / Failed loading resource lines in $log. Nothing was moved."
	fi
	echo "$label: godot exit 0"
}

FRAMES_TXT=""
F0=""
NFR=""
load_frames() {  # label log: FRAME lines into FRAMES_TXT; first index F0; count NFR; checks they are contiguous
	FRAMES_TXT="$( { strip_ansi "$2" | grep -E '^FRAME [0-9]+ '; } || true)"
	if [ -z "$FRAMES_TXT" ]; then
		stop "$1: no FRAME lines in $2"
	fi
	NFR="$(wc -l <<< "$FRAMES_TXT" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
	F0="$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' <<< "$FRAMES_TXT")"
	if ! awk 'NR == 1 { f0 = $2 } $2 != f0 + NR - 1 { bad = 1 } END { exit bad ? 1 : 0 }' <<< "$FRAMES_TXT"; then
		stop "$1: FRAME indices in $2 are not contiguous"
	fi
}

frame_line() {   # index -> the FRAME line with that process-frame index (from FRAMES_TXT)
	awk -v f="$1" '$1 == "FRAME" && $2 == f { print; exit }' <<< "$FRAMES_TXT"
}

NPNG=""
W=""
check_pngs() {   # label dir: counts frame<N>.png in NPNG, digit width in W; checks the numbers are 0..NPNG-1
	local names nums
	names="$( { ls "$2" | grep -E '^frame[0-9]+\.png$'; } || true)"
	if [ -z "$names" ]; then
		stop "$1: Movie Maker wrote no frame<N>.png in $2"
	fi
	NPNG="$(wc -l <<< "$names" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
	W="$(awk 'NR == 1 { print length($0) - 9 }' <<< "$names")"
	if ! awk -v w="$W" 'length($0) - 9 != w { bad = 1 } END { exit bad ? 1 : 0 }' <<< "$names"; then
		stop "$1: PNG names in $2 do not all have $W digits"
	fi
	nums="$(sed -E 's/^frame0*([0-9]+)\.png$/\1/' <<< "$names" | sort -n)"
	if ! awk '$1 != NR - 1 { bad = 1 } END { exit bad ? 1 : 0 }' <<< "$nums"; then
		stop "$1: PNG numbers in $2 are not contiguous from 0"
	fi
}

png_name() {     # index -> frame<index, W digits>.png
	printf "frame%0${W}d.png" "$1"
}

check_size() {   # label png
	local size
	size="$( { file -b "$2" | grep -oE '[0-9]+ x [0-9]+' | head -n 1; } || true)"
	if [ "$size" != "$WANT_SIZE" ]; then
		stop "$1: $2 is '${size:-unknown}', expected $WANT_SIZE. Nothing was moved."
	fi
}

map_run() {      # label outdir log: loads FRAME lines and PNGs, checks the counts match, prints the offset
	load_frames "$1" "$3"
	check_pngs "$1" "$2"
	if [ "$NPNG" != "$NFR" ]; then
		stop "$1: Movie Maker wrote $NPNG PNGs but $3 has $NFR FRAME lines, so PNGs cannot be matched to log frames. Nothing was moved."
	fi
	echo "$1: $NPNG PNGs = $NFR FRAME lines; first FRAME line is process frame $F0, so PNG index = FRAME index - $F0 (offset $F0)"
}

KEEP=""          # one line per kept frame: outdir \t ext \t source png \t new name \t frame \t png \t tick \t pose \t clip \t t \t cell \t expect
keep() {
	KEEP="$KEEP$(printf '%s\t' "$@")"$'\n'
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- land: trigger - 1 .. trigger + 4

CLEAN_TRIGGER=""
OVERLAY_TRIGGER=""
select_land() {  # variant(clean|overlay) outdir log ext
	local variant="$1" outdir="$2" log="$3" ext="$4" label="land $1"
	local result trig n tf td aligned tp rel fr line pose clip t tick cell rel_tick rig tag expect png ok
	map_run "$label" "$outdir" "$log"
	result="$( { strip_ansi "$log" | grep -E '^LAND PREVIEW: .* problems=0$'; } || true)"
	if [ -z "$result" ]; then
		stop "$label: no 'LAND PREVIEW: ... problems=0' line in $log (see its PROBLEM lines)"
	fi
	trig="$( { strip_ansi "$log" | grep -E '^TRIGGER '; } || true)"
	n=0
	if [ -n "$trig" ]; then
		n="$(wc -l <<< "$trig" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
	fi
	if [ "$n" != "1" ]; then
		stop "$label: expected exactly one TRIGGER line in $log, found $n"
	fi
	tf="$(kv "$trig" frame)"
	td="$(kv "$trig" touchdown_tick)"
	aligned="$(kv "$trig" aligned)"
	if [ "$aligned" != "true" ]; then
		stop "$label: TRIGGER line says aligned=$aligned: $trig"
	fi
	tp=$((tf - F0))
	if [ ! -f "$outdir/$(png_name "$tp")" ]; then
		stop "$label: TRIGGER frame $tf -> PNG index $tp, but $outdir/$(png_name "$tp") does not exist"
	fi
	echo "$label: TRIGGER frame=$tf (touchdown tick $td) -> PNG index $tp = $(png_name "$tp")"
	if [ "$variant" = "clean" ]; then
		CLEAN_TRIGGER="$tf/$tp"
	else
		OVERLAY_TRIGGER="$tf/$tp"
	fi
	for rel in -1 0 1 2 3 4; do
		fr=$((tf + rel))
		png=$((fr - F0))
		line="$(frame_line "$fr")"
		if [ -z "$line" ]; then
			stop "$label: no FRAME line for trigger $rel (frame $fr)"
		fi
		pose="$(kv "$line" pose)"
		clip="$(kv "$line" clip)"
		t="$(kv "$line" t)"
		tick="$(kv "$line" tick)"
		cell="$(kv "$line" cell)"
		rel_tick=$((tick - td))
		ok=1
		case "$rel" in
			-1)
				[ "$pose" = "FALL" ] && [ "$clip" = "-" ] || ok=0
				tag="trig-1_FALL"
				expect="Airborne FALL before contact"
				;;
			4)
				[ "$pose" = "IDLE" ] && [ "$clip" = "-" ] && [ "$rel_tick" = "8" ] || ok=0
				tag="trig+4_tick8_IDLE-handoff"
				expect="Tick 8: IDLE hand-off without a pop, seam or anchor shift"
				;;
			*)
				rig=$((2 * rel))
				if [ "$pose" != "LAND" ] || [ "$clip" != "land" ] || [ "$rel_tick" != "$rig" ] || ! near_frame "$t" "$rig"; then
					ok=0
				fi
				case "$rel" in
					0) tag="trig+0_rig0_impact"; expect="Frame 0: partial squash and planted feet" ;;
					1) tag="trig+1_rig2_deepest-squash"; expect="Frame 2: deepest squash, about the height of the low box" ;;
					2) tag="trig+2_rig4_same-squash"; expect="Frame 4: same squash, now beginning recovery" ;;
					3) tag="trig+3_rig6_eased-rise"; expect="Frame 6: eased rise, joined cut and fixed feet" ;;
				esac
				;;
		esac
		if [ "$ok" != "1" ]; then
			stop "$label: trigger $rel (frame $fr) does not show what the strip needs ($tag): $line"
		fi
		check_size "$label" "$outdir/$(png_name "$png")"
		keep "$outdir" "$ext" "$(png_name "$png")" "land_${variant}_${tag}_png$(printf "%0${W}d" "$png").png" \
			"$fr" "$png" "$tick" "$pose" "$clip" "$t" "$cell" "$expect"
	done
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scoot: one before, on and one after every swap and wrap

select_scoot() { # outdir log ext
	local outdir="$1" log="$2" ext="$3" label="scoot"
	local result events n ev kind kind_lc f dir k pos off fr png line pose clip t tick cell cf want_cell want_cf expect
	local right_swap=0 right_wrap=0 left_swap=0 left_wrap=0
	map_run "$label" "$outdir" "$log"
	result="$( { strip_ansi "$log" | grep -E '^SCOOT PREVIEW: .* problems=0$'; } || true)"
	if [ -z "$result" ]; then
		stop "$label: no 'SCOOT PREVIEW: ... problems=0' line in $log (see its PROBLEM lines)"
	fi
	events="$( { strip_ansi "$log" | grep -E '^(SWAP|WRAP) '; } || true)"
	if [ -z "$events" ]; then
		stop "$label: no SWAP or WRAP lines in $log"
	fi
	n="$(wc -l <<< "$events" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
	echo "$label: $n SWAP/WRAP lines"
	while IFS= read -r ev; do
		kind="$(awk '{ print $1 }' <<< "$ev")"
		kind_lc="$(tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' <<< "$kind")"
		f="$(kv "$ev" frame)"
		dir="$(kv "$ev" dir)"
		case "$dir/$kind" in
			right/SWAP) right_swap=$((right_swap + 1)); k=$right_swap ;;
			right/WRAP) right_wrap=$((right_wrap + 1)); k=$right_wrap ;;
			left/SWAP) left_swap=$((left_swap + 1)); k=$left_swap ;;
			left/WRAP) left_wrap=$((left_wrap + 1)); k=$left_wrap ;;
			*) stop "$label: unexpected event line: $ev" ;;
		esac
		for pos in before on after; do
			case "$pos" in
				before) off=-1 ;;
				on) off=0 ;;
				after) off=1 ;;
			esac
			fr=$((f + off))
			png=$((fr - F0))
			line="$(frame_line "$fr")"
			if [ -z "$line" ]; then
				stop "$label: no FRAME line $pos $kind at frame $f"
			fi
			pose="$(kv "$line" pose)"
			clip="$(kv "$line" clip)"
			t="$(kv "$line" t)"
			tick="$(kv "$line" tick)"
			cell="$(kv "$line" cell)"
			if [ "$clip" != "scoot" ]; then
				stop "$label: frame $fr ($pos $kind at $f) is not in the scoot clip: $line"
			fi
			cf="$(clip_frame "$t")"
			case "$kind/$pos" in
				SWAP/before) want_cell=0; want_cf=6; expect="Cell 0 (A), last tick of the A hold" ;;
				SWAP/on) want_cell=1; want_cf=7; expect="Cell 1 (B) at the swap: feet registered, no jump" ;;
				SWAP/after) want_cell=1; want_cf=8; expect="Cell 1 (B), second tick of the B hold" ;;
				WRAP/before) want_cell=1; want_cf=13; expect="Cell 1 (B), last frame of the loop" ;;
				WRAP/on) want_cell=0; want_cf=0; expect="Cell 0 (A) at the wrap: no hesitation, feet registered" ;;
				WRAP/after) want_cell=0; want_cf=1; expect="Cell 0 (A), second tick of the A hold" ;;
			esac
			if [ "$cell" != "$want_cell" ] || [ "$cf" != "$want_cf" ] || ! near_frame "$t" "$want_cf"; then
				stop "$label: frame $fr ($pos $kind at $f) shows cell $cell at clip frame $cf, expected cell $want_cell at $want_cf: $line"
			fi
			check_size "$label" "$outdir/$(png_name "$png")"
			keep "$outdir" "$ext" "$(png_name "$png")" \
				"scoot_${dir}_${kind_lc}${k}_${pos}_clip${cf}_cell${cell}_png$(printf "%0${W}d" "$png").png" \
				"$fr" "$png" "$tick" "$pose" "$clip" "$t" "$cell" "$expect, facing $dir"
		done
	done <<< "$events"
	echo "$label: right $right_swap swaps, $right_wrap wraps; left $left_swap swaps, $left_wrap wraps"
	if [ "$right_swap" -lt 2 ] || [ "$right_wrap" -lt 2 ] || [ "$left_swap" -lt 2 ] || [ "$left_wrap" -lt 2 ]; then
		stop "$label: expected at least two swaps and two wraps in each direction"
	fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- move the full sequences out, copy the kept frames back

move_full() {    # outdir ext log
	local outdir="$1" ext="$2" log="$3" f left
	mkdir -p "$ext"
	for f in "$outdir"/frame*; do
		if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
			stop "no Movie Maker files to move in $outdir"
		fi
		mv -n "$f" "$ext/"
	done
	left="$( { ls "$outdir" | grep -cE '^frame'; } || true)"
	if [ "$left" != "0" ]; then
		stop "$left Movie Maker files are still in $outdir after the move"
	fi
	cp "$log" "$ext/"
	echo "moved the full sequence: $outdir/frame* -> $ext/ (with a copy of $(basename "$log"))"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- run

run_capture "land clean" 30 res://previews/land_preview.tscn "$CLEAN_DIR" "$CLEAN_LOG" 0
run_capture "land overlay" 30 res://previews/land_preview.tscn "$OVERLAY_DIR" "$OVERLAY_LOG" 1
run_capture "scoot" 60 res://previews/scoot_preview.tscn "$SCOOT_DIR" "$SCOOT_LOG" 0

echo
echo "=== checks (nothing is moved unless all pass)"
select_land clean "$CLEAN_DIR" "$CLEAN_LOG" "$EXT_CLEAN"
select_land overlay "$OVERLAY_DIR" "$OVERLAY_LOG" "$EXT_OVERLAY"
if [ "$CLEAN_TRIGGER" = "$OVERLAY_TRIGGER" ]; then
	echo "land: clean and overlay TRIGGER frame/PNG are the same: $CLEAN_TRIGGER"
else
	echo "land: NOTE clean TRIGGER frame/PNG $CLEAN_TRIGGER differs from overlay $OVERLAY_TRIGGER (each run checked on its own)"
fi
select_scoot "$SCOOT_DIR" "$SCOOT_LOG" "$EXT_SCOOT"

echo
echo "=== moving"
move_full "$CLEAN_DIR" "$EXT_CLEAN" "$CLEAN_LOG"
move_full "$OVERLAY_DIR" "$EXT_OVERLAY" "$OVERLAY_LOG"
move_full "$SCOOT_DIR" "$EXT_SCOOT" "$SCOOT_LOG"
kept=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r outdir ext src name _rest; do
	if [ -z "$outdir" ]; then
		continue
	fi
	if [ ! -f "$ext/$src" ]; then
		stop "$ext/$src missing after the move"
	fi
	if [ -e "$outdir/$name" ]; then
		stop "$outdir/$name already exists (a frame kept twice?)"
	fi
	cp "$ext/$src" "$outdir/$name"
	kept=$((kept + 1))
done <<< "$KEEP"

echo
echo "=== kept frames ($kept): FIXTURE frames from res://previews/, not gameplay evidence"
printf '%-58s %6s %6s %6s %-8s %-6s %-9s %4s  %s\n' "file" "frame" "png" "tick" "pose" "clip" "t" "cell" "should show"
while IFS=$'\t' read -r outdir ext src name fr png tick pose clip t cell expect; do
	if [ -z "$outdir" ]; then
		continue
	fi
	printf '%-58s %6s %6s %6s %-8s %-6s %-9s %4s  %s\n' "$name" "$fr" "$png" "$tick" "$pose" "$clip" "$t" "$cell" "$expect"
done <<< "$KEEP"
echo
echo "Kept frames: $CLEAN_DIR/, $OVERLAY_DIR/, $SCOOT_DIR/ (logs beside them). Full sequences: $EXT/."
echo "RESULT: all three captures checked; $kept frames kept."

## A7 — landing, r0 (first verdict, mine, written before any Claude reading)

Capture: `captures/land/r0/clean/` and `captures/land/r0/overlay/` (fixture frames from `res://previews/land_preview.tscn`, Movie Maker at 30 fps, run by me with `sessions/a7/capture_strips.sh`; full sequences outside the repo). I also played the preview windowed at normal speed and at `--time-scale 0.25`.

- **Impact, hold, and rise:** Yes. The landing looked smooth at normal speed. In the clean frames, Jelly compresses on contact in 105, reaches its deepest squash in 106, holds it in 107, then rises in 108. The hold was easier to see frame by frame.
- **Seam:** I didn't see an obvious gap, overlap, or line where the two pieces meet during the squash or rise.
- **Feet:** Yes. At quarter speed, Jelly's bottom edge stayed planted on the plate as it squashed and rose.
- **Return to IDLE:** I didn't notice a pop. Between frames 108 and 109, Jelly gets a little taller while its bottom edge stays in the same spot relative to the plate.

## A7 — landing, r1: Claude's reading of r0 (agent)

Written by the agent (Claude Code, Step 7 r1 session) after Kiran's r0 verdict above. Frames read: the six clean frames in `captures/land/r0/clean/` (process frames 104–109) and the six overlay frames in `captures/land/r0/overlay/` (145–150), with their `STRIP` and `FRAME` lines in `land_clean.log` and `land_overlay.log`. Every log line agrees with the strip plan: `TRIGGER aligned=true`, ticks per frame 2, rel ticks 0/2/4/6/8, every `STRIP` line `ok=true`, `problems=0` in both runs. I read the frames at full size only (1280 × 720, unzoomed): my crop-and-enlarge command was denied. Every size below is my estimate from the full frame, about ±2 px, not a measurement; the jelly is about 64 px tall on screen, so 1 game px looks like about 1 screen px here.

| Kept frame | Phase table / strip plan | What the frame shows | Agree? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 104 / 145, trigger − 1, FALL | Airborne FALL before contact | The FALL drawing (dot eyes, flat mouth), upright, about 70 × 60 px, its bottom edge a few px above the plate rim. | Agrees |
| 105 / 146, rig 0, impact | Partial squash, planted feet | The drawing has changed to the IDLE face (smile). The bottom edge now sits on the rim, and the top is about 14 px lower than in 104: roughly 55 px tall, slightly wider. Small feet show at the base. | Agrees |
| 106 / 147, rig 2, deepest squash | About the height of the low box (44 px) | The flattest silhouette: roughly 43–44 px tall and about 75 px wide, a slab with the face still whole near the top. Bottom edge in the same place on the rim. The A6 crumbs appear on both sides of the feet. | Agrees |
| 107 / 148, rig 4, same squash | Same squash, recovery begins | To my eye the jelly is the same as in 106: same top, same width, same bottom. The only visible change is the crumbs, which have moved further out. | Agrees on the shape. "Recovery begins" cannot be seen in this frame: frame 4 is the start key of the rise, so the first recovered pose is tick 5, which a 30 fps strip does not capture. |
| 108 / 149, rig 6, eased rise | Eased rise, joined cut, fixed feet | Nearly upright again: about 57 px tall, width back near IDLE. Bottom edge unchanged. I see no line, gap or overlap across the body where the two pieces meet. | Agrees. The 0.5 ease-out puts frame 6 three quarters of the way back (lower height 0.90), so most of the rise (about 14 px) happens between 107 and 108. |
| 109 / 150, tick 8, IDLE hand-off | No pop, seam or anchor shift | The original IDLE sprite, about 63 px tall, roughly 6 px taller than 108, bottom edge in the same place. The step continues the direction of the rise. | Agrees, within what an unzoomed still can show |

Overlay frames: in all six, the plates, table and forks are drawn with their collision tint, and the jelly silhouettes match the clean frames at the same strip positions. At full-frame size I could not make out the player's own collision box outline, so I could not compare the 52 × 44 box with the frame-2 silhouette from these stills. The "about the low box" check rests on my height estimate, not on the overlay.

Where motion and phase table differ in visual terms: the phase table puts Active at 2–3 and Recovery at 4–7. On screen the squash is held at ticks 2, 3 and 4 (keys 2 and 4 are identical), so it reads as about 3 ticks (50 ms) of hold. Then the rise is front-loaded: about three quarters of it happens by tick 6. In the strip, the hold is two identical consecutive stills (106 and 107), each lasting 1/30 s, and the eye sees a repeated picture. At normal speed that same hold is only 50 ms, so it can easily blend into the rise. That is consistent with Kiran's note that the hold was easier to see frame by frame.

What I cannot judge from stills: smoothness and the feel of the easing (the 2.0 ease-in into frame 2 and the 0.5 ease-out after frame 4 act on ticks 1, 3, 5 and 7, and none of them is in a 30 fps strip); whether the feet stay planted and the cut stays joined on those odd ticks; any one-pixel filtering line at the cut, which needs a zoomed view; whether the rig's frame-8 rest is pixel-identical to the original IDLE sprite (the strip shows the original sprite at tick 8, not the rig at rest); and how long the hold feels at normal speed, which only Kiran's playtest can decide.
EOF

Strip: `captures/land_puff/r0/` (fixture capture; `land_puff_preview.tscn` with `retrigger` off; seeds 1001 and 1002; frames 10, 12, 15, 20, 30, 50). Effect settings: CHANGE-BRIEF.md Version 1, as built in commit `2bb6ebc`.
Where I looked: the running preview at the project's window size (1280 × 720), several runs, and the six strip frames.

What I saw (my words): In the live preview, I saw a quick puff that looked like white smoke under both jellies. At frame 12, it was easy to see on both the pale plate and the dark table. At frame 15, most of the crumbs were still under the jellies, so I didn't see the wide sideways fan I expected. The crumbs were gone by frame 20 and stayed gone in frames 30 and 50.

Claude's reading of r0: not yet requested.

### 2026-11-07 — Effect A, revision r1
What I saw (preview fixture and running game, 1280 × 720): my r0 verdict above. At frame 15 most crumbs were still under the jellies, with no wide sideways fan. In the running game a puff appeared at the jelly's feet on every landing, and the puffs all looked the same to me. On my r0 plate-edge attempt in the running game, I didn't see the two puffs overlap. That helped motivate trying a more visible sideways spread. I haven't verified overlap in r1.

Claude's reading of r0 (`sessions/a6/session-4a-reading.md`): frames 10, 30 and 50 match the intent; frame 12 does not have crumbs "out from behind both sides"; frame 15 fails, with a few crumbs just outside one edge and nothing near a jelly width out; frame 20 is empty. Its explanation: the LAND sprite is about 78 px wide, wider than the 52 px collision box the brief was sized to, and the push is too weak to carry crumbs past the visible edge. It read the frames unzoomed, because its three image-crop commands were denied.
